description: Stage 5 calibration ledger rows minted in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/calibration_record.py still build CAL-<plan_id>-<epoch> without a per-flow disambiguator, causing same-second collisions across concurrent flows.
goal: Update apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/calibration_record.py (and pass any needed branch/target context from apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/calibration/run.py while preserving existing public function signatures and row schemas) to append a deterministic per-flow disambiguator via build_stage_disambiguator from sandbox_executor.ledger so Stage 5 CAL-<plan_id>-<epoch>-<disambiguator> execution IDs are unique across two same-second calls from different flows or branches while keeping branch-length limits (ensure_stage_segment_fits) and existing CAL row schemas compatible. Keep calibration_record.py and calibration/run.py within their 350-line budgets and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched. Add regression tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_unique_stage_ids.py verifying two same-second calibration calls with different branches/slugs produce globally distinct CAL-* IDs under uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Adding a per-flow disambiguator to Stage 5 calibration execution IDs prevents silent ledger ID collisions across concurrent flows.
acceptance_criteria: The Stage 5 calibration id (`CAL-<plan_id>-...` in calibration_record.py / calibration/run.py, migrated out of calibration.py) includes a per-flow disambiguator (`build_stage_disambiguator`) and is distinct for two same-second calls from different flows.

Regression tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_unique_stage_ids.py show two same-second calls with different slugs or branches produce globally distinct `CAL-*` ids (and calibration_record.py / calibration/run.py stay within 350 lines with holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched).

Branch-length limits (`ensure_stage_segment_fits`) and existing row schemas are preserved, `uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
